blurb: Organized in 1879, Old Mobeetie is the oldest town in the Texas Panhandle. During the late 1800's, Mobeetie, the first county seat of Wheeler County and 26 other unorganized counties in Texas, was formed in the heart if the Native American's prized buffalo hunting grounds.
